title: Creative Live Update Unsupported Details
description: Typed details for CREATIVE_LIVE_UPDATE_UNSUPPORTED. Names the kinds of change the seller refused on a live creative and the packages that make it live, so the buyer can sync the change as a new creative_id and replace it on those packages.

refused_changes.description: Change kinds in the item that the seller does not apply in place to this live creative.

live_package_ids.description: Packages in the caller's account on which the creative is live. These are the packages on which to replace it.
